diagnosis_map.notes: Primary driver: nerve ischemia from microcirculatory failure + metabolic depletion. Garlic especially indicated (thick blood / diabetic context). Flow layer first; protection layer added.
Chemo depletes mitochondrial function (failure mode C dominant) + damages microcirculation (B secondary). Avoid premature stimulation. Build metabolic base first.
Mixed pattern: local flow disruption + sensitized central processing post-surgery. Sequence: flow restoration then noise buffering.
Nerve root compression + fascia-EZ field collapse. Distinction from idiopathic: positional component, dermatomal distribution. EZ field support plus spinal herbs.
No clear structural cause. Failure-mode profiling required (A, B, C weighting). Score all three failure modes and treat dominant first.
Structural depletion, no active inflammation. Build: Collagen → MyBlood → ProCardiol. Never introduce Collagen during active inflammation. Cold-stiff phenotype.
Active immune-inflammatory excess. Stabilise and reduce noise first. Never stimulate. Collagen contraindicated during active phase. Structure only later.
Phase-dependent — see Batch 1. Key error: building on active inflammation. Assess phase before every intervention.
Uterine field lacks downward Yang support. Blood stagnation + cold EZ → uterine spasm. Not primarily hormonal. Field rehydration + Shaoyin sink restoration needed.
Fluid enclosure not primarily hormonal — field stagnation + cold matrix in pelvic EZ grid. Pelvic EZ rehydration and Shaoyin reconnection required.
Fascia-bound fluid, poor lateral drainage, GB-Dai Mai axis frozen. Two possible entry points: pelvic field collapse or Shaoyang downstream overload.
Central axis instability. Ligaments fail to hold due to loss of field tension (EZ collapse), not purely mechanical instability.
Anterior pelvic ring collapse — simultaneous fascia + ligament + EZ weakening. Treat as pelvic field collapse.
Field model: joint fluid becomes 'dead water' — low zeta, high friction, chronic micro-stress. Also maps to OA yin joint. Treat pelvic EZ field first if pelvic context present.
Grid collapse at pelvic level — EZ breakdown in urogenital fascia.
Same grid collapse, different anatomical window. Field medicine approach: pelvic EZ grid restoration.
Core upstream driver of pelvic field collapse. Mitochondrial collapse → EZ grid failure → lower burner cold → upper body compensatory heat. Treat as Shaoyin-KD depletion.

Field model: severity of symptoms correlates with EZ field coherence, NOT anatomical stenosis degree. A hydrated, resilient EZ grid can buffer even significant compression. Asymptomatic stenosis = intact EZ field. Severe symptoms with mild MRI = EZ collapsed.
Real dysfunction often EZ layer collapse on endothelium (glycocalyx damage → disturbed ion/proton flow) as much as anatomical stenosis. Treat blood-EZ field + Yin collaterals.

Western model fails to explain persistence, imaging mismatch, or shifting pain. Integrative: Du meridian Qi stagnation + ligament micro-inflammation + fascial swelling disrupting EZ. Emotional root (fear, shock) common. Field model explains symptoms without visible structural damage.
Taiyang pathology secondary to Shaoyin dissociation — Taiyang (Bladder meridian) congests when Shaoyin cannot absorb energy.
Taiyang pathology: Shaoyin sink cannot absorb energy → Taiyang overdistends (Bladder meridian: venous-CSF dynamics disturbed). Treat Shaoyin sink first.

Blood must carry compensatory magnetic field load when mitochondrial function drops (adrenal fatigue). Blood sludging + rouleaux formation → increased viscosity → hypertension. Address mitochondrial base and EZ grid.

rules.condition: neuropathy failure mode profiling: burning + night worsening + allodynia + gabapentin partial
rules.action: classify as failure mode A (signal overload) — treat with noise buffering layer: Spirulina + Magnesium + Melatonin (if night)

rules.condition: neuropathy failure mode profiling: numbness + cold extremities + swelling + heavy aching
rules.action: classify as failure mode B (microcirculatory failure) — treat with flow layer: MyBlood + Ginger (if cold) + Garlic (if diabetic/thick)

rules.condition: neuropathy failure mode profiling: fatigue + weakness + chemo history + poor recovery
rules.action: classify as failure mode C (mitochondrial fatigue) — structural + metabolic support: Spirulina low dose + Astaxanthin + Vitamin D+Nigella; avoid premature stimulation

rules.condition: neuropathy: reassessment at 10-21 days shows noise reduced
rules.action: shift primary focus from noise buffering to flow restoration (failure mode A → B priority shift)

rules.condition: neuropathy: reassessment shows flow improved
rules.action: shift primary focus to structural protection layer

rules.condition: neuropathy: medication helps pain but causes cognitive fog
rules.action: flag tachyphylaxia / excessive noise suppression; add noise buffering environmental support; do not escalate dose

rules.condition: neuropathy: medication helped initially then stopped working
rules.action: flag tachyphylaxia; assess system capacity (A/B/C failure mode); stabilise before escalating

rules.condition: neuropathy: medication helps pain but sleep still poor
rules.action: add Melatonin (if overstimulated at night) + Spirulina; sleep is separate layer from pain suppression

rules.condition: joint: hot, red, swollen
rules.action: treat as RA (yang joint) pattern — reduce noise, stabilise; DO NOT build structure, DO NOT stimulate

rules.condition: joint: cold, stiff, degenerative, no systemic signs
rules.action: treat as OA (yin joint) pattern — build structure (Collagen → MyBlood → ProCardiol)

rules.condition: joint: mixed (some heat, some stiffness)
rules.action: calm first, build later — apply phase sequencing from Batch 1 mixed OA-RA rules

rules.condition: ALWAYS
rules.action: never build structure (Collagen) into active inflammation — universal joint rule

rules.condition: pelvic pain present
rules.action: always check for concurrent signs of adrenal fatigue and low back pain — pelvic pain is not a local problem

rules.condition: pelvic pain + cold lower limbs + mental overdrive/insomnia
rules.action: classify as cold-heat vertical dissociation — treat Shaoyin sink first, not locally

rules.condition: pelvic pain treatment: NSAID prescribed
rules.action: flag: NSAID insufficient alone — vertical field not addressed; add EZ rehydration + Shaoyin bridge support

rules.condition: pelvic pain treatment: hormonal therapy prescribed
rules.action: flag: PCOS/dysmenorrhoea not primarily hormonal — add pelvic EZ grid restoration alongside

rules.condition: pelvic pain treatment: warming herbs only prescribed
rules.action: flag: warming herbs alone insufficient — vertical axis must be reconnected; Shaoyin sink reactivation required

rules.condition: steroid injection given for pelvic/spinal pain
rules.action: flag: steroids temporarily restore EZ integrity but do not reweave fascia-water-electric scaffold; add pelvic EZ rebuilding protocol alongside; repeated injections → Yin exhaustion

rules.condition: LSS on MRI but symptoms mild or absent
rules.action: classify as intact fascia-EZ field — do not over-treat structurally; focus on EZ maintenance

rules.condition: mild LSS on MRI but debilitating neurogenic claudication
rules.action: classify as EZ field collapse — treat EZ rehydration + spinal fascia restoration; not primarily a surgical problem

rules.condition: neurogenic claudication: symptoms worsen when upright / improve with flexion
rules.action: flexion-based postures prescribed; spinal EZ field opens with flexion and collapses with extension — use this for therapeutic positioning

rules.condition: neurogenic claudication: cold lower limbs + mental overthinking + Du meridian tightness
rules.action: classify as EZ field signs — begin spinal EZ rehydration protocol (Tai Zi Shen, Huang Jing, Sheng Di, etc.)

rules.condition: vascular claudication: cramping resolves quickly with rest + predictable distance trigger
rules.action: classify as vascular claudication — treat blood-EZ field restoration; Dan Shen + Hong Hua + Chuan Xiong + Niu Xi

rules.condition: NSMBP: pain persists post-acute, imaging mismatch, shifting pain, emotional overlay
rules.action: classify as Du meridian Qi stagnation + fascial swelling; treat EZ disruption + emotional root; not purely mechanical

rules.condition: NSMBP: stiffness on waking
rules.action: flag as fascia slow to rehydrate — EZ disruption; prioritise fascia field hydration herbs

rules.condition: neuropathy: all three failure modes present
rules.action: calculate weighted score per mode (A%, B%, C%); treat highest-weight mode first; sequence to secondary

rules.condition: neuropathy: do not stack multiple adaptogens
rules.action: maximum one adaptogen layer at a time; sequence, do not stack

rules.condition: adrenal fatigue confirmed or suspected
rules.action: treat as primary upstream driver — Shaoyin sink reactivation before local pelvic or structural treatment

field_medicine_concepts.definition: Structured water layer forming around fascia, endoneurium, and endothelium; buffers mechanical stress; enables bioelectric signal transmission; coherent EZ = resilient; collapsed EZ = amplified pain even from minor compression
field_medicine_concepts.clinical_relevance: EZ collapse = pain without visible structural damage; EZ intact = asymptomatic despite MRI stenosis

field_medicine_concepts.definition: Peripelvic fascia + microvascular + lymphatic + neural field unit; torus-like resonator; components: central axis (Du Mai), lateral grid (iliopsoas, pelvic floor, gluteus), ring stabilizers (SI fascia, round ligament, inguinal field)
field_medicine_concepts.clinical_relevance: collapse → pain appears at weakest anatomical node: L5-S1, psoas spasm, pudendal neuralgia, hip arthritis, prostatitis — same collapse, different windows

field_medicine_concepts.definition: Shaoyin HT-KD disconnection: upper body accumulates compensatory heat (LV Yang / Shaoyang overdrive); lower body enters cold stagnation (pelvic EZ collapse); not a temperature problem — a coherence problem
field_medicine_concepts.clinical_relevance: explains upper symptoms (insomnia, eye strain, palpitations) co-existing with lower symptoms (cold pelvis, pelvic pain, cold limbs)

field_medicine_concepts.definition: Corticosteroids temporarily restore EZ integrity by: reducing local nitric oxide → less EZ disintegration; inhibiting inflammation = reduced Brownian chaos; mild kosmotropic effect via phospholipid membrane. BUT: do not reweave fascia-water-electric scaffold; freeze disintegration only; repeated use → Yin exhaustion
field_medicine_concepts.engine_rule: if_steroid_given: add pelvic/spinal EZ rebuilding protocol alongside; do NOT rely on steroids as sole field restoration

field_medicine_concepts.definition: Spine/fascia = fascia-bound fluid-electromagnetic antenna; dural sleeves + arachnoid + EZ water = liquid-crystalline transmission cable; conducts Qi, bioelectric charge, proprioceptive feedback; stenosis alone insufficient without EZ collapse to cause symptoms
field_medicine_concepts.clinical_relevance: explains imaging-symptom mismatch in LSS and NSMBP

notes: Batch 2 introduces three major new clinical domains: (1) neuropathy failure-mode profiling (A/B/C weighted scoring), (2) OA vs RA decision tree, (3) pelvic pain as cold-heat vertical field dissociation.
The neuropathy flow includes a 9-screen app logic structure that maps directly to input variable collection and failure-mode scoring.
The OA/RA decision tree is the upstream classifier for all joint patterns — it must fire before any joint intervention is selected.
Pelvic pain module introduces the largest TCM herb library in any batch so far — 40+ new herbs, all structured with roles and meridian targets.
The Shaoyin Sink Reboot formula is a complete 11-herb formulation — engine should store as a named compound formula object.

EZ field concepts (pelvic EZ grid, vertical dissociation, steroid as emergency EZ restoration, fascia as superconductor) are foundational field medicine constructs used across multiple patterns — stored as shared concept library.
Magnesium added as a non-herbal supplement to the noise buffering and metabolic layers.
All herb entries in herb_library_new_entries are new to Batch 2 — no duplicates from Batch 1 (MyGastrin, MyBlood, etc.) unless a new functional role is specified.
Claudication differentiation (neurogenic vs vascular) is a new subdomain not present in Batch 1 — critical for spinal/peripheral pain triage.
